summary: Join Gender in Climate Change Policy Training to explore the intersection of gender and climate action. Equip yourself with essential skill for impactful change
lede: Gender-responsive climate policy considers how climate risks and responses affect people differently and brings those perspectives into climate action. For professionals designing, implementing or evaluating climate policies and programs, the course develops skills in intersectional vulnerability analysis, gender-disaggregated monitoring, and gender-responsive budgeting.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals responsible for the design, implementation, and evaluation of climate-related policies and programs across public, private, and non-profit sectors.
modules: Global Frameworks and the UNFCCC Gender Action Plan
Climate Adaptation and Community Resilience Strategies
Gender-Responsive Climate Finance and Resource Mobilization
Monitoring, Evaluation, and International Reporting Standards
Developing the Gender-Responsive Climate Action Roadmap
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of climate change policy or social development frameworks. Prior experience in policy drafting, project management, or environmental advocacy is recommended. No specific software is required, though familiarity with data analysis concepts is beneficial.
